description: This PHP source file appears to be part of the vTiger CRM system. It manages the display and retrieval of custom field configurations for various modules within the CRM, including functions to get custom field entries and mappings, as well as rendering the custom field list interface.

methods.name: getCFListEntries
methods.description: Retrieves list of custom fields for a module, including their labels, types, and delete options.

methods.name: getCFLeadMapping
methods.description: Retrieves the custom field mapping for lead conversion for a specific module.

methods.name: getListLeadMapping
methods.description: Fetches assignment mappings for a specific lead custom field.

methods.name: getCustomFieldSupportedModules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that support custom fields in the CRM system.
